Attached: 1 image

Our Hysteria2 connections went silent about 60 seconds into every upload speed test. The QUIC connection stayed alive and DNS kept working, but no web traffic got through. Port hopping, congestion control, ISP shaping and stream limits were all ruled out.

The cause was a flow-control stall in the Hysteria server, and the fix was about 37 lines of Go. A thread 🧵

#QUIC #Golang #Networking #OpenSource
